title: Pulsar Sipper Triple Quartz Coil Atomizers – 5 Pack
description:
These atomizers are an official replacement part for the Pulsar Sipper Vaporizer. Featuring three wrapped quartz rods, these heating elements maximize surface area to provide quick and consistent vaporization of concentrates. Sold as 5 atomizers per box.

Pulsar Sipper Atomizer Features:
5 Atomizers per Box
Triple Quartz Atomizers
Official Replacement Part for the Pulsar Sipper Vaporizer

What’s in the Box:
5x – Pulsar Sipper Replacement Triple Quartz Coils
